WoW Forever • One-day dungeon route

The Road to the Spire

From Stratholme’s supply crates to Drakkisath’s throne. Finish the Charger, level your priest, and collect gear for both roles along the way.

  • 5 dungeon stops
  • 8–10 hours with prep
  • Level 60 Prot Paladin + level 58 Priest

Forever UBRS guide · General Drakkisath’s Demise

Optional: finish your own Seal of Ascension

Once one player has the ring and all three gems, return to Vaelan. Take the Unforged Seal and Orb to Emberstrife in the Wyrmbog, Dustwallow Marsh. Bring help. Place the seal near the weakened dragon, stop DPS when his will falters, use the Orb, then breathe Flames of the Black Flight onto the seal. Loot it and return to Vaelan. If the gems don’t drop, keep your keyed UBRS run and save the forge detour for later. Forge quest

Priest: build Shadow and healing kits

Devout upgrades to Virtuous. If Shadow is your main spec, pick Virtuous Wraps at the first exchange and build a healing kit from drops. If healing is your main spec, choose Virtuous Bracers. The upgrade consumes the base piece; a vendor opens after the full chain. Start with Deliana in Ironforge at level 58+: Devout Bracers, 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20g. Devout Bracers and Gloves are BoE from Stratholme Living. Later, the Living-side Of Love and Family chain leads to Fordring’s Seal for healing. Tier 0.5 route · Shadow BiS · Healing BiS

Paladin: balance Defense with spell power

Build around tank Soulforge for hybrid gear, with Deathbone and Draconian Deflector for hard pulls. At Deliana’s first exchange, choose Soulforge Wristguards (+3 Defense) with Lightforge Bracers, 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20g. Sageblade is a later crafted threat target; don’t spend Charger gold on it. Sanctified Orb is an optional class-quest reward from Forging the Mightstone, not part of the mount quest. 440 total Defense is a level-63 crit-prevention benchmark, not a requirement for this route. Protection BiS · Blizzard riding and Soulforge hotfixes

Route swaps, if you already started the Charger

Already have five Holy Waters? You can start with Dire Maul West → Scholomance, then do Stratholme. Already blessed the barding? Swap Dire Maul West for Stratholme Living for the priest’s Devout BoEs and the Of Love and Family painting if that quest is active. If you completed the Charger quest before the riding hotfix and still lack the skill, ask Grayson for the free riding dialogue.
